'''Minos Porter''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a key strategist during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Porter was also a member of the [[Outreach Bureau]], an Imperial agency responsible for the distribution of information and news.
